project.name: GPS School Management Domain Graph
project.description: Business-domain flow graph for the GPS school management application, covering tenant access, institution setup, student lifecycle, learning operations, finance and operations, and the portal experience.

nodes.name: Identity and Access
nodes.summary: Handles signup, login, JWT sessions, refresh-token rotation, tenant membership resolution, permissions, roles, and route-level scope checks. This domain is the access gate used by almost every other GPS domain.

businessRules: Refresh tokens are stored as hashes, not plaintext.
Route access is enforced by JWT tenant context and scope checks.
Role and permission assignment uses tenant-scoped replace semantics.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides authenticated tenant context to all tenant-scoped domains.
Supplies scopes used by portal ABAC and NestJS route guards.

nodes.name: Institution Setup
nodes.summary: Manages the tenant, school, campus, academic structure, classrooms, sections, subjects, timetable, transport network, and staff or teacher profiles that define how a school operates.

businessRules: All records are tenant-scoped.
School and campus codes are unique in their owning scope.
Timetable slots prevent duplicate class/day/start-time collisions.
Transport assignments are unique per student and academic year.
crossDomainInteractions: Provides schools, classes, teachers, and routes used by student, attendance, homework, exams, billing, and transport flows.

nodes.name: Student Lifecycle
nodes.summary: Covers the path from admission application through enrollment, student profile management, guardian linkage, class assignment, promotion, and exit handling.

businessRules: Admission applications follow allowed status transitions.
Student admission numbers are unique per school.
Soft-deleted students and guardians are excluded from reads and links.
Guardian-student links must belong to the same school context.
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes school and classroom structure from Institution Setup.
Feeds attendance, exams, billing, communications, documents, transport, and portal search.

nodes.name: Learning Operations
nodes.summary: Coordinates day-to-day academic activity: student and teacher attendance, homework, exams, assessments, and result publication.

businessRules: Attendance record writes use bulk upsert keyed by session and student.
Teacher attendance allows one record per teacher per date.
Exam status moves from draft to published to completed.
Student assessments are unique per exam subject and student.
crossDomainInteractions: Depends on students, classes, subjects, and teachers.
Produces academic progress and daily operational records shown in the portal.

nodes.name: Finance and Operations
nodes.summary: Handles fee plans, invoices, payments, document metadata, communications, and operational records around school administration.

businessRules: Decimal financial values use Prisma Decimal.
Payment allocation recalculates invoice balance and status.
Documents store metadata and link polymorphically to business entities.
Direct-message recipients are validated before sending.
crossDomainInteractions: Uses student, school, staff, and tenant identities to scope billing, documents, and communications.

nodes.name: Portal Experience
nodes.summary: Provides the React administrative interface for login, signup, dashboard onboarding, class setup, student management, teacher directory, and attendance marking.

businessRules: Forms use react-hook-form and zod validation.
Runtime API data is parsed with zod schemas.
Portal access checks use auth guards and ABAC policy.
crossDomainInteractions: Calls API flows through authenticated HTTP clients.
Surfaces key Institution Setup, Student Lifecycle, and Learning Operations workflows to staff users.

nodes.name: User Signup
nodes.summary: Creates a user in an active or trial tenant, creates membership, and issues initial access and refresh tokens.

nodes.name: Validate signup payload
nodes.summary: Validate user identity, email, password, and tenant code input.

nodes.name: Create active tenant membership
nodes.summary: Create the user and user_tenants membership for the resolved tenant.

nodes.name: Issue initial token pair
nodes.summary: Create access and refresh tokens for the new user session.

nodes.name: Persist hashed session token
nodes.summary: Store the refresh token hash and expiry in the sessions table.

nodes.name: User Login and Session Refresh
nodes.summary: Authenticates credentials, resolves tenant membership, rotates refresh sessions, and exposes the current JWT payload.

nodes.name: Validate credentials and tenant membership
nodes.summary: Check user password and active tenant membership for the login request.

nodes.name: Compute roles and scopes
nodes.summary: Resolve role assignments and permission scopes for the JWT payload.

nodes.name: Create authenticated session
nodes.summary: Issue token pair and persist a hashed refresh token session.

nodes.name: Rotate refresh token
nodes.summary: On refresh, revoke the old session and create a new token-backed session.

nodes.name: Return current user context
nodes.summary: Expose the authenticated JWT payload through the me endpoint.

nodes.name: RBAC Administration
nodes.summary: Manages permission catalog, tenant roles, role permissions, and user membership assignments.

nodes.name: List permission catalog
nodes.summary: Return global non-deleted permission records.

nodes.name: Create or update tenant roles
nodes.summary: Maintain tenant-scoped role metadata with conflict checks.

nodes.name: Replace role permissions
nodes.summary: Validate permission keys and replace the role-permission set transactionally.

nodes.name: Replace membership roles
nodes.summary: Validate role keys and replace a user-tenant membership role set.

nodes.name: Tenant and School Setup

nodes.name: Resolve current tenant

nodes.name: Create or update schools
nodes.summary: Maintain tenant-scoped school records with unique school code checks.

nodes.name: Maintain campuses

nodes.name: Assign school administrators

nodes.name: Classroom and Subject Setup

nodes.name: List academic structures
nodes.summary: Read tenant-scoped classrooms, sections, subjects, and enrollments while excluding soft-deleted rows.

nodes.name: Create classrooms with sections
nodes.summary: Create a class and multiple sections with duplicate checks for class/year/section.

nodes.name: Create subjects
nodes.summary: Create school-scoped subjects with unique subject code validation.

nodes.name: Assign student enrollment
nodes.summary: Create or update the student academic-year enrollment and prevent duplicate enrollment.

nodes.name: Staff and Teacher Management
nodes.summary: Maintains staff profiles and creates teacher profiles from existing staff records.

nodes.name: List staff and teachers
nodes.summary: Read tenant-scoped staff and teacher records for directory views.

nodes.name: Create staff profile
nodes.summary: Create staff with employee-code and school/user uniqueness checks.

nodes.name: Update staff profile
nodes.summary: Patch staff metadata for an authenticated tenant.

nodes.name: Create teacher profile
nodes.summary: Create a teacher profile from an existing staff profile.

nodes.name: List timetable entries
nodes.summary: Read tenant-scoped active timetable entries.

nodes.name: Derive school from classroom

nodes.name: Create or update slot

nodes.name: Map slot collision errors
nodes.summary: Translate unique class/day/start-time conflicts into stable API errors.

nodes.name: Transport Route Assignment
nodes.summary: Maintains vehicles, routes, stops, and student transport assignments.

nodes.name: Maintain vehicles
nodes.summary: Create or update school-scoped vehicles with unique vehicle numbers.

nodes.name: Maintain routes and stops
nodes.summary: Create or update route codes and stops in the tenant transport network.

nodes.name: Assign students to routes
nodes.summary: Create or update student route assignments for an academic year.

nodes.name: Enforce transport uniqueness
nodes.summary: Reject duplicate vehicles, routes, and student assignment combinations.

nodes.name: Admission to Enrollment
nodes.summary: Tracks applications through review decisions and converts approved applications into enrolled student records.

nodes.name: Create admission application
nodes.summary: Capture applicant and guardian information in an admission application.

nodes.name: Validate status transition

nodes.name: Stamp workflow dates

nodes.name: Create student and guardian records

nodes.name: Mark application enrolled

nodes.name: Student Records Management

nodes.name: Create student with admission number

nodes.name: Update student profile
nodes.summary: Patch student details inside the authenticated tenant.

nodes.name: Soft delete student
nodes.summary: Mark a student deleted instead of removing the row.

nodes.name: Bulk import students
nodes.summary: Import student rows from JSON or CSV with required field validation.

nodes.name: Guardian Linking

nodes.name: Create or update guardian
nodes.summary: Maintain guardian identity and contact records.

nodes.name: Validate same-school relationship

nodes.name: Link guardian to student
nodes.summary: Create or update the StudentGuardian relationship and primary guardian flag.

nodes.name: Unlink guardian from student

nodes.name: Find siblings by guardian

nodes.name: Create promotion batch request
nodes.summary: Capture a promotion batch request for student progression.

nodes.name: Update promotion mappings
nodes.summary: Represent class or section mapping updates for promotion processing.

nodes.name: Update promotion overrides
nodes.summary: Represent per-student override decisions for promotion processing.

nodes.name: Create exit request
nodes.summary: Capture student exit workflow input for lifecycle completion.

nodes.name: Student Attendance Marking

nodes.name: Create attendance session
nodes.summary: Create a tenant-scoped class/date attendance session.

nodes.name: Choose target students

nodes.name: Apply selected status

nodes.name: Apply remaining status

nodes.name: Bulk upsert records

nodes.name: Teacher Attendance

nodes.name: List teacher attendance
nodes.summary: Filter attendance by school, teacher, date range, and tenant.

nodes.name: Check daily duplicate
nodes.summary: Prevent more than one teacher attendance record per teacher/date.

nodes.name: Create teacher attendance
nodes.summary: Persist school, teacher, date, status, and remarks.

nodes.name: Update teacher attendance

nodes.name: Homework Assignment

nodes.name: List homework
nodes.summary: Read tenant-scoped active homework records.

nodes.name: Create homework

nodes.name: Update homework
nodes.summary: Patch homework details for the authenticated tenant.

nodes.name: Soft delete homework

nodes.name: Exam and Assessment Publishing

nodes.name: Fee Plan and Invoice Management

nodes.name: Create invoice

nodes.name: Update invoice metadata

nodes.name: Create payment

nodes.name: Build download placeholder

nodes.name: Mark notification read

nodes.name: Validate message recipients
nodes.summary: Ensure direct-message recipients are valid tenant members.

nodes.name: Send direct message

nodes.name: List mailbox view

nodes.name: Submit login request

nodes.name: Render signup form

nodes.name: Compute setup progress
nodes.summary: Mark setup steps complete when backing records exist.

nodes.name: Render navigation shell

nodes.name: Expose command search

edges.description: Identity and Access supplies tenant identity and scopes for tenant, school, staff, timetable, and transport administration.
Student and guardian operations use JWT tenant context and route scopes.
Attendance, homework, and exams are protected by scopes resolved from roles and permissions.
Billing, documents, notifications, and messages are all tenant/user scoped through authenticated context.
Schools, classrooms, academic years, and enrollments define where students belong.
Learning operations consume student rosters, enrollments, guardians, classes, and teachers.
Student records anchor invoices, documents, notifications, and transport assignments.
Classrooms, subjects, timetable entries, and teachers drive attendance, homework, and exams.
School and tenant setup scopes fee plans, invoices, document links, and communications.
Portal authentication UX calls Identity and Access APIs and applies ABAC checks.
Portal setup screens expose school, class, staff, and teacher administration.
Portal student pages expose student search, class placement, and enrollment management.
Portal attendance pages call attendance session and marking flows.
